items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: my aunt Mattie held me in her arms. That's when she went and bought me a drum.

ctx.x: Helmicke, that later on played with the Goldman band up in Central Park. The last time I saw him Max Roach Art Blakey, he was 86 years old. I took ____, I took Blakey, I took Joe Harris out to hear this man play this bass drum. He was the highest priced man in the band at Central Park. The bass drum hit my stomach and I never relinquished that feeling. That was my indoctrination to music. I couldn't keep still; my aunt Mattie held me in her arms. That's when she went and bought me a drum.

What I would like to do is things that I - have about three sections of articles and things - I've thrown away a lot of things and I dedicated in from the very beginning to what I would do. I wrote a thing in the articles and things that I have that hasn't been published, "Peoples I've Met". I cover the 48 states and I would like to make a jump from where we are now to start in the year 1930, which would be important.
